video_start_source: Original inner-ZIP extended Unix modification time minus decoded video duration.
assumption: The archived modification time is close to the end of recording; file flush latency and cross-device clock offsets are unknown.
supporting_evidence: Reference ZIP file modification seconds coincide with the final recorded notification/session stop seconds; container and sampled video do not supply a verified shared timestamp.
shift_sign: Positive shifts place video start later on the reference UTC clock.
sensitivity_interpretation: Illustrative timestamp-assumption shifts only, not a confidence interval, error bound, or selection of the smallest error.
reference_kind: User-designated Polar device HR notifications; not ECG; physiological notification delay is unknown.
reference_aggregation: Arithmetic mean of finite positive HR notifications in [window_center-5,window_center+5).
reference_coverage: Window must lie inside first-reference to last-reference plus median interval; at least two reference values; no internal timestamp gap greater than 2 seconds.
reporting: Primary metrics remain conditional on this timestamp assumption; all six frozen branches, own and common windows, output coverage and full-reference R5 denominators.
waveform_snr: Hann full-window Welch, NFFT=8192, band 0.7–3.5 Hz, reference HR H1 +/-0.1 Hz.
